uncited: The methods in this family share the mechanism of hierarchical decomposition and error-driven or distance-driven primitive selection, building on [Splatting](23-splatting.md).
**Adaptive Traversal and Selection:** During rendering, the hierarchy is traversed from the root to the leaves.
**Primitive Aggregation:** When a node is selected, its children are merged into a single representative primitive.
The use of octrees in volume rendering dates back to the early 1990s.
